about: remotefm1.com/move's release states (js/move.js reads it). What depends on a release not out yet is null or false here, and the page shows it as "coming with the release" instead of a number. Set each when it ships: remotefm14move when RemoteFM14Move's module is released (its version, the release page, how many firmwares the package bundles and their size unpacked, whether Schwung Manager lists it); apps when the iOS / Android apps ship the Ableton Move controller. The Wi-Fi firmware's state is not here: the page and its flasher read web/installer/releases.json (a release with a "wifi" package).
